problem:
Evaluate the triple integral 

$$
{∭}_{R}\frac{y{e}^{z}}{{x}^{2}}\,\text{d}V
$$

over the box $R={(x,y,z)\,:\,\frac{\sqrt{2}}{4}\le x\le \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2},\,0\le y\le 1,\,0\le z\le \operatorname{ln}⁡5}.$

examples.knowledge_point: Evaluating a Triple Integral Using the Product Rule
examples.problem:
Evaluate the triple integral 

$$
\displaystyle 
\iiint\limits_{R} y \cos{x} \sin{z} \: \textrm{d}V
$$

over the box $R = \bigg\{ (x,y,z) \: : \: 0 \leq x \leq \dfrac{\pi}{2}, \: 0 \leq y \leq 1, \: 0 \leq z \leq \pi \bigg\}.$
examples.worked_solution:
First, we express our triple integral as a repeated integral:

$$
\begin{aligned}{∭}_{R}y\operatorname{cos}⁡x\operatorname{sin}⁡z\,\text{d}V & ={\int }_{0}^{\pi }{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{\pi /2}y\operatorname{cos}⁡x\operatorname{sin}⁡z\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}z\end{aligned}
$$

Since the domain of integration $R = \left[0,\pi/2\right]\times[0,1]\times\left[0,\pi\right]$ is a rectangular box, and the integrand can be expressed as $f(x)\cdot g(y)\cdot h(z),$ we can rewrite our repeated integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{\pi /2}\operatorname{cos}⁡x\,\text{d}x\,{\int }_{0}^{1}y\,\text{d}y\,{\int }_{0}^{\pi }\operatorname{sin}⁡z\,\text{d}z\end{aligned}
$$

Evaluating each integral separately, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{\pi /2}\operatorname{cos}⁡x\,\text{d}x\,{\int }_{0}^{1}y\,\text{d}y\,{\int }_{0}^{\pi }\operatorname{sin}⁡z\,\text{d}z & =[\operatorname{sin}⁡x]_{0}^{\pi /2}\cdot {[\frac{{y}^{2}}{2}]}_{0}^{1}\cdot [-\operatorname{cos}⁡z]_{0}^{\pi } \\  & =(1-0)\cdot (\frac{1}{2}-0)\cdot (1-(-1)) \\  & =1\cdot \frac{1}{2}\cdot 2 \\  & =1.\end{aligned}
$$

feedback.problem:
Express the triple integral 

$$
{∭}_{R}\frac{1}{\sqrt{y{x}^{3}({z}^{2}-1)}}\,\text{d}V
$$

over the box

$$
R={(x,y,z)\,:\,1\le x\le 2\sqrt{3},\,2\le y\le 3,\,-3\le z\le -2}
$$

as a repeated integral of the form 

$$
{\int }_{a}^{b}{\int }_{c}^{d}{\int }_{e}^{f}…\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}z\,\text{d}y.
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
Given the limits for $x,y,$ and $z,$ we can express our triple integral as a repeated integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{∭}_{R}\frac{1}{\sqrt{y{x}^{3}({z}^{2}-1)}}\,\text{d}V & ={\int }_{2}^{3}{\int }_{-3}^{-2}{\int }_{1}^{2\sqrt{3}}\frac{1}{\sqrt{y{x}^{3}({z}^{2}-1)}}\,\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}z\,\text{d}y\end{aligned}
$$
